# Alcarcia — Full discography

> Personal site of Alcarcia (aka Damalga): Spanish electronic music producer, graphic designer and web developer. This is the expanded index; Same content as 'llms.txt' plus every tracklist inline, with a direct Bandcamp link for each track.

Alcarcia is the music alias of Damalga. Six releases published between 2018 and 2025 across four independent labels: Illegal Alien Records, Polymorphism Records, ALCATAPES and Global Offensive Corporation. Site is a React sandbox built with minimum dependencies (React 19, Vite, SCSS, Lenis for 'smooth scroll'), sourced from a single 'data.json'.

- Album: [BoSsOb](https://illegalalienrecords.bandcamp.com/album/bossob-ep)

- Format: Digital
- Label: [Illegal Alien Records](https://illegalalienrecords.bandcamp.com)

Tracklist:
